events.verdict: Harris (LAC) and DeRozan (SAS) engage and disengage during the screen.
On the screen Aldridge (SAS) does not give Williams' (LAC) room to avoid the contact.
Williams (LAC) makes high-five contact with Forbes (SAS)'s hand after he has released the ball.
Williams (LAC) engages with Forbes (SAS) but does not affect his FOM.
Harrell (LAC) establishes legal position in Forbes' (SAS) path and firms up on his right leg during the pick.
Harrell (LAC) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he receives the ball and makes a continuous motion towards the basket.
Belinelli (SAS) makes contact with Harrell (LAC)'s arm and affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Belinelli (SAS) engages with Harris (LAC) during the rebound but does affect his ability to get to the ball.
Forbes (SAS) engages with Williams (LAC) off ball but does not affect his ability to defend.
Aldridge (SAS) establishes legal position in Gallinari's (LAC) path and firms up on his right leg during the screen.
LLB shows Harrell (LAC) makes contact with DeRozan's (SAS) arm that affects his drive to the basket.
Gallinari (LAC) engages with Aldridge (SAS) in the lane and affects his FOM.
Belinelli (SAS) briefly grasp Gallinari's (LAC) jersey off ball but does not affect his FOM.
Mills (SAS) places two brief hands on Gallinari (LAC) as they disengage from the screen but does not affect his FOM.
Mills (SAS) engages with Gallinari (LAC) in the post but does not affect his FOM.
Belinelli (SAS) engages with Harris (LAC) during the rebound but does not affect his ability to get to the ball.
Forbes (SAS) maintains a legal guarding position on Williams (LAC)'s jump shot.
Aldridge (SAS) establishes legal position in Harris' (LAC) path and slight extends his backside but does not affect Harris' (LAC) ability to defend.
Harris (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position on DeRozan (SAS)'s driving shot.
Gallinari (LAC) establishes legal position in Forbes' (SAS) path and absorbs contact made during the pick.
Cunningham (SAS) makes contact with Gallinari (LAC)'s arm and affects his driving shot attempt.
RAR shows - Harrell (LAC) cleanly dislodges the ball as DeRozan (SAS) attempts to gather the pass.
Belinelli (SAS) commits a take foul on Gallinari (LAC).
DeRozan (SAS) engages with Beverly (LAC) during the inbound but does not affect his ability to defend.
Beverly (LAC) makes marginal contact with DeRozan (SAS) as he brings the ball up the floor but does not affect his SQBR.
Beverley (LAC) moves laterally into DeRozan (SAS)'s path at the start of his drive, but does not affect his SQBR.
Forbes (SAS) wraps Williams (LAC) during the inbound.
Beverley (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position on Forbes (SAS)'s jump shot.
Aldridge (SAS) engages with Harrell (LAC) during rebounding but does not affect his ability to get to the ball.
